description: The classic room-deleter. Cannon mode wipes packs, alt-fire Barrage melts single targets. Hunter Munitions slash procs on crits ignore armor — that's the one-shot engine.

mods.name: Semi-Shotgun Cannonade
mods.note: Huge base damage, made for the Zarr

mods.name: Critical Delay
mods.note: Crit chance (fire-rate penalty barely matters here)

mods.name: Hunter Munitions
mods.note: Slash procs on crits — the one-shot engine

mods.name: Vigilante Supplies
mods.note: Exilus — ammo economy, the Zarr's weak point

name: Kuva Zarr — One-Shot Steel Path
playstyle: Cannon mode for crowds (shoot the ground), alt-fire Barrage for single targets. Tap reload while bullet-jumping to stay at 5/5 mag — ammo starvation is the only thing that stops this build.
progenitor: Toxin (combines with cold mods for Viral)

description: Cluster bombs that carpet an area. Still one of the most reliable Steel Path clearers — shoot above a pack and let the bomblets finish the job.
name: Kuva Bramma — One-Shot Steel Path
playstyle: Aim above packs, not at them — bomblets rain down. Slower than the Zarr per shot but each shot covers a huge area.

description: Charge the Incarnon form and it becomes a hitscan delete beam. One of the hardest-hitting primaries in the game once transformed.
name: Phenmor — One-Shot Steel Path (Incarnon)
playstyle: Get headshot kills in normal form to charge Incarnon, then transform and hold the beam on priority targets. Melts Acolytes and Archons.

description: A wall of plasma per shot. Huge damage per trigger pull with innate punch-through — point it at a hallway and everything dies.

mods.name: Hunter Munitions
mods.note: Slash procs on the big crits

name: Tenet Arca Plasmor — Strong All-Rounder
playstyle: One wide plasma wave per shot — aim center-mass down corridors. Radiation or Viral depending on progenitor and faction.

description: Builds charges on kill, then the Incarnon form fires devastating void beams. Arguably the best secondary in the game for Steel Path.
name: Laetum — One-Shot Steel Path (Incarnon Pistol)
playstyle: Farm a few kills to charge Incarnon, transform, and beam down everything. The alt-fire radial blast handles crowds.

description: Chains microwave beams across enemies stacking tons of statuses. The best primer in the game — paint a pack with statuses, then one-tap them with your primary or melee.
name: Kuva Nukor — Status Primer / Strong Secondary
playstyle: Sweep the beam across a pack for 1-2 seconds, then swap to your main weapon. With 4+ status types stacked, Galvanized mods and Condition Overload go crazy.

description: Throw it, detonate mid-air, watch the map explode. Heavy-attack thrown detonations scale insanely and one-shot Steel Path packs.

mods.name: Amalgam Organ Shatter
mods.note: Crit damage + heavy attack wind-up speed

name: Glaive Prime — One-Shot Heavy Attack
playstyle: Heavy-attack throw into packs and manually detonate. Build combo counter first on stragglers for maximum Blood Rush scaling.

description: Mesmer Skin makes you literally unkillable while charges last. The easiest frame to take into hard Steel Path content — press 2 and walk forward.

mods.name: Blind Rage
mods.note: Power strength for Mesmer Skin charges

name: Revenant — Unkillable Steel Path Frame
playstyle: Keep Mesmer Skin (2) up at all times — recast when charges run low. Enthrall (1) + Reave (3) deletes thralls for energy and health.

description: Spores + Toxic Lash spread viral/toxin across the whole map. The fastest Steel Path clearer for exterminate and survival farms.
name: Saryn — Room Nuke (Steel Path Farm Queen)
playstyle: Cast Spores (1) on an enemy, pop it with Toxic Lash (3)-buffed weapon, watch spores spread. Keep Miasma (4) for burst. Recast spores before they fall off.

description: Defy gives you 3 free deaths per cast and your Celestial Twin doubles your damage. The comfiest frame for almost any content.
name: Wukong — Lazy Immortal (Strong General)
playstyle: Keep the Twin (1) summoned, Defy (3) ready for its free revives, Cloud Walker (2) to skip anything annoying. The Twin uses your primary — give it your best weapon.

description: Iron Skin makes you immune to damage and knockdown. The classic recommendation for new players pushing through the star chart into Steel Path.

mods.name: Ironclad Charge
mods.note: Augment — Iron Skin scales with enemies hit

name: Rhino — Best Starter Tank (Strong General)
playstyle: Charge (1) through a pack, cast Iron Skin (2) — now you're immune. Roar (3) buffs your whole squad's damage. Stomp (4) for crowd control.

description: Cordon yanks every enemy within 30m into one tight ball every 15s — shoot the ball once with your Zarr/Bramma and the whole pack dies.
name: Nautilus Prime — Best Sentinel for AoE Builds
playstyle: Let Cordon group packs, then delete them with AoE. The bond mods buff your fire rate and crit damage passively.
weaponNote: Equip Verglas Prime with a status build — its statuses feed Manifold Bond.

name: Rhino — Unkillable Starter Tank
description: Press 2 (Iron Skin) and walk through the star chart like nothing can touch you. The single best frame for learning the game.
playstyle: Cast Iron Skin (2) whenever it breaks, charge (1) through crowds for fun, stomp (4) when surrounded. You are the wall — your team will love you.

mods.name: Vitality
mods.note: More health to feed Iron Skin

name: Excalibur — Exalted Blade Starter
description: Your starter frame's ultimate turns him into a melee god. Cheap mods, huge damage, zero fuss.
playstyle: Build energy, press 4 (Exalted Blade), and swing. Radial Blind (2) stuns rooms when you need breathing room.

mods.name: Flow
mods.note: Energy to keep the blade out

mods.name: Steel Fiber
mods.note: You will be in melee range

name: Volt — Speed Demon Starter
description: Run fast, hit hard, shield up. Volt's kit teaches you everything about ability synergy.
playstyle: Drop Electric Shield (3), shoot through it for bonus damage. Speed (2) to zoom, Shock (1) to stun. Discharge (4) clears rooms.

name: Mag — Magnetize Starter
description: One of the starter frames with a trick that scales forever: Magnetize turns enemy bullets into a blender.
playstyle: Cast Magnetize (2) on a tough enemy, shoot into the bubble. Pull (1) groups crowds into it. Crush (4) strips armor.

name: Oberon — Starter Healer
description: The paladin frame. Heal your squad, strip armor, and never die. Everyone wants an Oberon on defense missions.
playstyle: Keep Renewal (3) running, stand on Hallowed Ground (2) for bonus armor, Reckoning (4) strips armor off everything.

mods.name: Phoenix Renewal
mods.note: Cheat death once per while — Oberon augment

name: Frost — Defense Wall Starter
description: The defense mission king. Drop a Snow Globe and the objective is safe. Simple, effective, always wanted.
playstyle: Snow Globe (3) on the objective, Avalanche (4) to freeze and strip armor. Freeze (1) for single targets.

mods.name: Vitality
mods.note: You stand in the open a lot

name: Ember — Fire Starter
description: Set the world on fire. Ember's kit is pure damage and it feels amazing on early star chart missions.
playstyle: Inferno (4) rains meteors, Fire Blast (2) strips armor, keep moving and everything burns.

name: Trinity — Energy Battery Starter
description: The support every squad wants. Infinite energy for the team and you literally cannot die.
playstyle: Energy Vampire (2) on enemies for team energy, Blessing (4) for full heal + damage resist, Link (3) to stay alive.

name: Loki — Stealth Starter
description: Go invisible and walk past everything. The spy-mission king and the fastest way to learn the game solo.
playstyle: Invisibility (2) always on, Decoy (1) to distract, Radial Disarm (4) to neuter gun enemies. Hack consoles in peace.

name: Boltor — Starter Rifle
description: The workhorse rifle that carries new players through the star chart. Nails enemies to walls. Literally.
playstyle: Aim for the torso, hold trigger. The innate punch-through and ragdoll keep crowds controlled.

mods.name: Infected Clip
mods.note: Toxin — the other half of Viral/Corrosive

name: Hek — Shotgun Room Clearer
description: Four barrels of 'no'. The Hek deletes everything on the early star chart and its augment makes it scale further.
playstyle: Get close, aim center-mass, delete. Scattered Justice augment adds multishot and a justice proc.

mods.name: Frigid Blast
mods.note: Cold — the other half of Viral

name: Karak — Reliable Auto Rifle
description: The Grineer rifle that just works. Accurate, hard-hitting, and easy to mod for any faction.
playstyle: Burst-fire at range, full-auto up close. Swap elements per faction with the 60/60 mods.

name: Atomos — Chain Beam Starter
description: A beam that chains between enemies. Point at a crowd and watch it melt. One of the best early secondaries.
playstyle: Hold trigger, sweep across groups. The chain does the aiming for you.

name: Lex — Pocket Sniper Starter
description: A hand cannon with sniper accuracy. One shot, one kill through most of the star chart.
playstyle: Aim for heads, fire slow and deliberate. Pairs perfectly with a fast primary.

name: Skana — First Sword Starter
description: Your first real sword. Fast, simple, and with the right mods it stays relevant way longer than it should.
playstyle: Spam melee, use slam attacks (jump + melee) for crowds. Keep combo counter up.

name: Bo — Long Staff Starter
description: Huge range for a starter weapon. You hit enemies before they can touch you.
playstyle: Keep distance, sweep wide arcs. The range is the whole point — abuse it.

name: Revenant — Mesmer Skin God Mode
description: The closest thing to immortality in Warframe. Mesmer Skin shrugs off hits that would one-shot anything else. Your frame, your rules.
playstyle: Keep Mesmer Skin (2) up — recast when charges run low. Enthrall (1) spreads, Reave (3) deletes thralls for massive damage. Danse Macabre (4) for crowds.

name: Saryn — Spore Nuke Steel Path
description: Infect the whole map and watch the kill counter explode. The premier Steel Path farmer and nuke frame.
playstyle: Cast Spores (1) on an enemy, pop it with a weapon to spread. Toxic Lash (3) for weapon damage, Miasma (4) to detonate everything.

mods.name: Regenerative Molt
mods.note: Heal on Molt cast — Saryn augment

name: Wukong — Celestial Twin Steel Path
description: Your twin does double damage while you literally cannot die. The laziest strong build in the game.
playstyle: Summon Celestial Twin (1), give it your best weapon, go invisible with Cloud Walker (2) and let the twin murder everything. Defy (3) for armor.

name: Mesa — Peacemaker Steel Path
description: The gunslinger. Peacemaker auto-aims and deletes Steel Path enemies faster than you can blink.
playstyle: Shooting Gallery (2) for damage, Shatter Shield (3) for 95% damage reduction, Peacemaker (4) to erase rooms. Keep regulators modded for crit.

mods.name: Mesa's Waltz
mods.note: Move while in Peacemaker — Mesa augment

name: Nekros — Desecrate Loot Farmer
description: Double the loot from every corpse. The frame you bring when you want twice the resources, mods, and parts.
playstyle: Keep Desecrate (3) always on — it re-rolls every corpse for extra drops. Terrify (2) for crowd control, Shadows (4) for meat shields.

mods.name: Despoil
mods.note: Desecrate costs health instead of energy — Nekros augment, the whole build

mods.name: Shield Of Shadows
mods.note: Damage reduction per shadow — Nekros augment

name: Khora — Pilfering Strangledome Farmer
description: Strangle the room, loot it twice. Khora's augment turns her CC into a farming machine that also shreds Steel Path.
playstyle: Strangledome (4) on spawns, Whipclaw (1) with the augment to execute. Venari heals you. Double loot from everything caught.

mods.name: Pilfering Strangledome
mods.note: Enemies in the dome drop extra loot — Khora augment

name: Volt — Eidolon Hunter
description: The Eidolon meta pick. Electric Shield doubles amp crit damage — that's how you one-shot the Teralyst's shields.
playstyle: Drop shields (3) for your amp DPS, Speed (2) to reposition, Shock (1) to break limbs. Coordinate with your squad's DPS.

mods.name: Capacitance
mods.note: Shields for the squad on Discharge — Volt augment

name: Chroma — Eidolon DPS
description: The big-number frame. Vex Armor multiplies your damage into the millions for Eidolon limb breaks.
playstyle: Take damage to charge Vex Armor (3), pop Elemental Ward (2) for heat, then dump everything into the limb. Time it with Volt shields.

mods.name: Vitality
mods.note: You need to TAKE damage safely

name: Saryn — Sanctuary Onslaught Leveler
description: The fastest affinity farm in the game. Spores + a good weapon = max rank in minutes.
playstyle: Spores (1) on everything, keep the kill chain going. The zone moves fast — keep up and keep spores spreading.

mods.name: Regenerative Molt
mods.note: Heal on the move — Saryn augment

name: Mirage — Sanctuary Onslaught Nuker
description: Prism + Hall of Mirrors turns every room into a laser light show. Elite Onslaught speed-clearer.
playstyle: Hall of Mirrors (1), Eclipse (3) for damage, Prism (4) to nuke. Keep moving — the zone timer is always ticking.

mods.name: Total Eclipse
mods.note: Share Eclipse with squad — Mirage augment

name: Titania — Archon Hunt Shredder
description: Shrink down, fly fast, and melt Archons with Dex Pixia. The Archon hunt speedrun frame.
playstyle: Razorwing (4) for tiny mode, Dex Pixia shreds bosses. Spellbind (1) for status immunity, Tribute (2) for buffs.

mods.name: Aviator
mods.note: Damage reduction while airborne — made for Titania

name: Tenet Arca Plasmor — One-Shot Steel Path
description: A wall of plasma that deletes hallways. Radiation + crit = Steel Path crowds evaporate in one trigger pull.
playstyle: Aim at head height down corridors. The wide projectile + punch-through clears rooms. Reload is the only downtime.
progenitor: Magnetic (pairs with toxin for Viral, or heat for raw damage)

mods.name: Frigid Blast
mods.note: Cold — the other half of Viral

name: Nataruk Steel Path One-Shot
description: The silent bow that deletes Steel Path. Perfect-release charged shots crit massively, and Hunter Munitions turns those crits into armor-ignoring slash bleeds. Learn the release timing (fire at the chime) and everything dies.

mods.name: Hunter Munitions
mods.note: Slash procs on crits — the one-shot engine

name: Felarx Steel Path One-Shot
description: Incarnon shotgun with homing projectiles that devastate crowds. The Incarnon form fires seeking shots — build crit + viral + slash and watch rooms evaporate.

mods.name: Primed Ravage
mods.note: Crit damage for the Incarnon form

mods.name: Hunter Munitions
mods.note: Slash procs on crits — armor irrelevant
